Multi Pop publishes a separate release for each device. Pick yours and download the installable ZIP and `SHA256SUMS` from its newest release:

| Device | Newest release | Install guide |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AYN Thor | [`thor-` releases](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/releases?q=thor-&expanded=true) | [Thor README](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/tree/main/systems/thor#install) |
| Anbernic RG DS | [`rgds-` releases, not `rgds-plus-`](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/releases?q=rgds-&expanded=true) | [RG DS README](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/tree/main/systems/rgds#readme) |
| Anbernic RG DS Plus | [`rgds-plus-` releases](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/releases?q=rgds-plus-&expanded=true) | [RG DS Plus guide](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/blob/main/systems/rgds/docs/rgds-plus.md) |
| AYN Odin 2 (Single Pop) | [`odin2-` releases](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/releases?q=odin2-&expanded=true) | [Odin 2 README](https://github.com/ballardcm/multi-pop/tree/main/systems/odin2#install) |

This entry has no files of its own. It is marked as the repository's Latest release so that GitHub's "Latest" link leads here rather than to one device's download; a release built for another device will not install on yours.
